Archived work orders
SKUs you archived from Work order coverage with Create Work Order or Covered, or by clicking Create Work Order in the Priority Queue / Planning — hidden from those lists. Restore if you clicked by mistake; once a real work order shows up in a data refresh, this entry stops mattering.
SKUDescriptionTypeDate
Production planning
Look up a finished-good SKU to see whether there's an opportunity to open a work order, based on current raw material stock.
This list only shows SKUs with no open work order (any status — Created, Scheduled, In Progress, or Split). If a SKU already has a work order in progress, it won't appear here — check Production Reports or the "Production order" column on Overview instead.

Raw material requirements are estimated from historical work orders (raw material consumed ÷ finished units produced). Raw materials tracked by weight often use a _KG suffix (e.g. RCF vs RCF_KG) — each is matched to its own stock record and unit of measure, so figures for the two variants aren't combined. For SKUs currently at stockout risk, the "Opportunity" badge is replaced by the same incoming-shipment verdict shown in the Priority Queue (hover it for full purchase order detail). "Covered" means a shipment is already on the way and no new work order is needed. Other SKUs keep the simple stock-based Yes/No check.

"Suggested WO qty" targets 2 months of stock coverage based on monthly sales; it's capped by nothing here, so if it's larger than "Max units producible" you don't have enough raw material on hand or incoming to fully close the gap in one work order.

The "Opportunity" badge and "Create Work Order" button only appear when available inventory is below 2 months of sales. If your available stock already covers 2 months, it shows "no need" instead. SKUs without a monthly sales figure fall back to the simple raw-material-only check, since there's no 2-month target to compare against.

Click any column header to sort — once for ascending, again for descending, a third time to go back to the default order. Hover a SKU to see its open sales orders (customer, PO number, order date, ship cancel). Use "Dismiss" to hide a SKU from this list with a reason — it also disappears from every other screen and shows up under Overview's "Dismissed items".

Production reports
Every open work order, grouped by where it stands in the production process
A blinking red work order number means it's been open more than 30 days since it was created — hover it to see exactly how long.
Work order coverage
For every SKU that already has an open work order: is what's still left to produce enough to cover the open sales orders?
Balance after WO = Available + quantity left on its work order(s). Available already has open orders subtracted (negative = orders waiting for stock), so orders are not subtracted a second time. This is a quantity check only — it doesn't compare the WO schedule with ship-cancel dates. Create Work Order opens the production system; Covered just archives the SKU. Either way it leaves this list and is kept under Archived.
